findings.description: The implementation returns the start date when n == 0 regardless of whether the start date falls on a weekend, violating the contract that specifies that n == 0 should return the following Monday if the start is on a weekend.
findings.evidence: add_business_days(date(2026, 11, 5), 0) returns date(2026, 11, 5) but should return date(2026, 11, 7).

review.summary: Candidate fails to handle n == 0 correctly on weekend start dates, returning the start date instead of the following Monday as required by the specification.
